* '''Playtest''' ([[Vengeance (V) (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-vengeance-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/vengeance.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 6 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Whenever you win a battle here, opponent loses 1 Force.”
* '''Original''' ([[Vengeance (V)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-vengeance-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/vengeance.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 6 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Whenever you win a battle here, opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; the two icons in the right-hand column are now coloured; same words.
*: [[File:V11-D-vengeance-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
